Because the 2021 takeover terms reserved future John Laing investments to KKR, the 64% John Laing interest is represented once under KKR with its direct holding vehicle, not duplicated as a separate John Laing and KKR stake.

companyFieldUpdates.name: Ontario Science Partners General Partnership
companyFieldUpdates.description: Ontario Science Partners General Partnership is the ProjectCo delivering the new Ontario Science Centre at Ontario Place in Toronto under a C$1.04 billion design-build-finance-maintain concession. The approximately 400,000-square-foot scope includes the new centre and rehabilitation of the Cinesphere and Pods, followed by a 30-year maintenance term. The ProjectCo reached financial close on February 11, 2026 with John Laing holding 64%, Sacyr Infrastructure Canada 26% and Amico Major Projects 10%. John Laing's interest is attributed to KKR because the 2021 takeover terms reserved all future John Laing investments to KKR; the project is outside the legacy JLIL/Equitix portfolio. Construction began in May 2026 with opening targeted for 2029, and no later sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
